title: ADHD Therapy & Executive Functioning Coaching

items.text: ADHD Therapy & Executive Functioning Coaching

Struggling with Focus, Organization, or Follow Through? ADHD is not just about attention, it affects planning, time management, and daily functioning. Whether you are a student, teen, or adult, these challenges can impact your confidence and productivity. I offer ADHD therapy and executive functioning coaching to help you build practical systems to stay organized, focused, and in control. Start Feeling More in Control

Signs You Might Need Support Do You Often Experience…? Difficulty staying focused on tasks Procrastination or trouble getting started Poor time management Forgetfulness or frequently losing things Feeling overwhelmed by simple tasks Trouble completing what you start Start Feeling More in Control
Therapy vs Coaching – What’s the Difference?

ADHD Therapy I focus on emotional regulation, self awareness, and managing stress, anxiety, or frustration linked to ADHD. Executive Function Coaching I focus on practical skills like planning, organizing, prioritizing, and building routines that actually work in real life.
My Approach How I Help You Succeed
1 Understand your unique challenges 2 Identify patterns and triggers 3 Build personalized systems & routines 4 Practice real-life strategies 5 Track progress and adjust as you grow

title: Trauma-Informed Therapy

items.text: Trauma-Informed Therapy

Trauma Informed Therapy “Sometimes, it is not about what happened, but how it stays with you.” You may find yourself reacting strongly, feeling overwhelmed, or struggling to feel safe even when everything seems fine. This is often how trauma shows up. I offer trauma-informed therapy to help you understand these experiences with compassion, not judgment. Start Feeling More in Control

Creating a Foundation of Safety Trauma-informed therapy begins by creating a sense of emotional and mental safety. I focus on building trust so you can express yourself openly, without fear or pressure. A Judgment-Free Environment You are not rushed or forced to share anything before you are ready. I guide each session with respect, empathy, and understanding. Understanding Your Experience Trauma can affect how you respond to everyday situations. I gently help you explore your experiences and recognize patterns without feeling overwhelmed. Building Resilience at Your Own Pace Healing is not about rushing; it is about steady and meaningful progress. I guide you in developing tools that help you feel calmer, stronger, and more balanced.

The Healing Journey What Healing Can Look Like It does not start with fixing everything. It starts with feeling safe. Then slowly, you begin to understand your patterns. I guide you in learning ways to calm your mind and body. We process your experiences at a pace that feels right for you. Over time, things begin to feel lighter, clearer, and more manageable.

title: Mindfulness-Based Therapy

items.text: Mindfulness-Based Therapy

What is Mindfulness Based Therapy? Mindfulness-based therapy helps you become fully present in the moment without judgment. I combine traditional therapeutic techniques with mindfulness practices such as breathing exercises, body awareness, and meditation. This approach helps you observe your thoughts and emotions rather than becoming overwhelmed by them. Instead of reacting automatically, I help you respond with greater clarity and calmness. Start Your Journey

Understanding Mindfulness-Based Therapy Mindfulness-based therapy helps you stay grounded in the present moment while calmly observing your thoughts and emotions. It helps reduce mental clutter and build emotional awareness. Present Moment Awareness I help you focus on the present moment instead of worrying about the past or future, creating a greater sense of calm and control. Non Judgmental Thinking I help you develop the ability to observe your thoughts without labeling them as good or bad. Improved Sleep Quality I help you understand your emotions more clearly instead of reacting impulsively to them. Mind Body Connection I help you become more aware of how your thoughts affect your physical and emotional state.

How It Helps You Mindfulness-based therapy is highly effective in helping you manage stress, anxiety, depression, and emotional challenges. It helps you break the cycle of negative thinking and develop a healthier relationship with your mind. By practicing mindfulness regularly, you gain better control over your emotions and improve your overall mental well-being. Reduced stress and anxiety Improved focus and clarity Better emotional regulation Enhanced self-awareness Support in managing depression and burnout

title: Anger Management

items.text: Anger Management

Understanding Anger & Emotional Control Anger management is not about suppressing your feelings, it is about learning how to express them in a healthy and constructive way. It involves recognizing early signs of anger, identifying triggers, and applying techniques to stay calm and in control. Start Feeling More in Control

When Anger Starts Affecting Your Life Recognizing the early warning signs can help you take control before anger begins to impact your relationships, health, and daily life. Frequent Outbursts You find yourself losing control over small issues. Relationship Conflicts Arguments and misunderstandings become more common. Physical Reactions Increased heart rate, muscle tension, or aggressive behavior. Calming Down It takes a long time to cool off after getting angry.

My Approach to Anger Management My approach focuses on helping you understand the root causes of your anger while equipping you with practical tools to manage it effectively. I combine proven therapeutic techniques with personalized guidance to help you respond calmly, think clearly, and build healthier emotional habits. Start Your Journey
